# Curefoods

> Curefoods is India's house of food brands, building and scaling category-defining F&B brands — from healthy meals to biryani, pizza to desserts — out of 281 cloud kitchens, 99 kiosks and 122 restaurants.

- Legal name: Curefoods India Pvt. Ltd.
- Founded: 2020 by Ankit Nagori
- Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Scale (as of March 31, 2025): 281 cloud kitchens, 99 kiosks, 122 restaurants
- Core purpose: Create Iconic Food Brands
- Core values: Love for Food, Do More with Less, Act Like an Owner, Pursuit of Excellence
- Contact: hello@curefoods.in | Support: support@curefoods.in | Press: press@curefoods.in | Careers: careers@curefoods.in

## Brands
- [Eatfit](https://www.eatfit.in/): Healthy Bowls. Eatfit is Curefoods' flagship healthy-eating brand, delivering calorie-tracked, macro-balanced meals. Cities: Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Coimbatore, Mysore, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Chandigarh.
- [Sharief Bhai Biryani](https://www.shariefbhai.com): Biryani, Mandi, Shawarma & More. Sharief Bhai Biryani was born from a deep respect for Dakhni Muslim household cuisine — the kind of food prepared with care for a dawat, served generously, and shared with pride. Cities: Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Mysore, Mangalore, Manipal, Tumkur, Hassan, Puducherry, Hosur, Palakkad.
- [OLIO](https://www.oliopizza.in): Pizza & Italian. OLIO is a young, delivery-first pizza brand known for its smoky charred crust, stretchy real cheese and bold, craveable toppings. Cities: Ahmedabad, Aurangabad, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Chennai, Coimbatore, Delhi, Dharwad, Faridabad, Gurgaon, Guwahati, Hubli, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Ludhiana, Mumbai, Nagpur, Nashik, Noida, Pune, Salem, Surat, Vadodara.
- [Arambam](https://www.arambam.com): Flavours of South India. Arambam is Curefoods' celebrity-backed South Indian brand, bringing the comforting flavours of the South together with the goodness of millets, offering regional favourites from across five South Indian states on one menu. Cities: Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Vizag, Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Pune, Bhopal, Ujjain, Coimbatore.
- [Krispy Kreme India](https://www.krispykremeindia.in): Doughnuts & Coffee. Krispy Kreme is a global doughnut and coffee brand operated by Curefoods in India with presence across 10 cities and 150+ locations. Cities: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Pune.
- [Nomad Pizza](https://www.nomadpizza.in/): Gourmet Pizza. Nomad Pizza brings artisanal, hand-stretched pizzas with globally inspired toppings to Curefoods' delivery network — crafted for the premium everyday pizza experience. Cities: Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Ahmedabad, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Dehradun, Indore, Goa, Hyderabad.
- [CakeZone](https://cakezone.com/): Cakes & Celebrations. CakeZone is a leading dessert brand in India, bringing irresistible cakes and desserts to customers across 60+ cities through 200+ outlets. Cities: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Coimbatore, Indore.
- [Frozen Bottle](https://frozenbottle.com): Milkshake, Dessert & Ice-Cream. Frozen Bottle is Curefoods' cold-dessert brand, serving thick milkshakes, ice-cream sundae jars, boba and Belgian waffles that are 100% vegetarian and 100% eggless. Cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Gurugram, Kerala.

## Cities served (any brand)
Ahmedabad, Aurangabad, Bangalore, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Chennai, Coimbatore, Dehradun, Delhi, Delhi NCR, Dharwad, Faridabad, Goa, Gurgaon, Gurugram, Guwahati, Hassan, Hosur, Hubli, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Kerala, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Ludhiana, Mangalore, Manipal, Mumbai, Mysore, Nagpur, Nashik, Noida, Palakkad, Puducherry, Pune, Salem, Surat, Tumkur, Ujjain, Vadodara, Vizag

## Disambiguation
- Curefoods is NOT the same company as Rebel Foods (a separate Indian cloud-kitchen company).
- Krispy Kreme India is a master-franchise partnership: Curefoods operates the India business; the brand and global IP belong to Krispy Kreme.
- Sharief Bhai operates in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu (plus Puducherry and Kerala border towns), not Hyderabad/Telangana.
